query:
UPDATE eval_experiment
             SET subject = jsonb_set(
                     jsonb_set(subject, '{kind}', '"agent_draft"'),
                     '{path}', to_jsonb($3::text))
             WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND dataset_path = $2
                   AND subject ->> 'kind' = 'draft' AND subject ->> 'path' = $4
             RETURNING id
